(2) The body corporate shall be deemed to be a voluntary
social service organization within the meaning and for the
purpose  of  the  Voluntary  Social  Service  Organizations
(Registration and Supervision) Act, No. 31 of 1980 and the
provisions  of  that  Act  shall  apply  to  and  in  relation  to  the
management of the affairs of the Corporation.
3. (1) The general objects for which the body corporate is
constituted are hereby declared to be —

(a)
to formulate a course of action to uphold the historic
value of the Upcountry Amarapura Sect and appreciate
the services to the Buddhist religious order (Sasana)
by  the  priests  who  had  been  resident  at  the  Sri
Sudharmarama Raja Maha Vihara in Batagalla from
its inception and giving priority to it; and

(b)
to use the strategies necessary in directing Buddhist
people towards the three-fold meritorious deeds.
(2)  In  the  implementation  of  the  objects  specified  in
subsection  (1),  the  Corporation  shall  ensure  that  such
implementation  shall  be  carried  out  without  any
discrimination  based  on  race,  religion,  language,  caste,
gender,  political  opinion,  place  of  birth  or  any  of  such
grounds.

4.
The  objects  of  the  body  corporate  shall  be  carried
out in such manner so as not to create any conflict between
the work of the Corporation and any work being carried out
simultaneously  by  any  Ministry  or  Department  of  the
Government or any Provincial Council.
